newsitem.title: CHINA: China Wuhan Iron '96 profits hit 700 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China Wuhan Iron '96 profits hit 700 mln yuan.

text.p: China's Wuhan Iron and Steel Co, or Wugang, made 700 million yuan ($84 million) in after-tax profits in 1996, the China Business Times said on Friday.
The newspaper did not give comparative figures.
Pre-tax profits of Wugang, based in Wuhan, capital of central China province of Hubei, reached 2.3 billion yuan in 1996, it said.
Wugang produced 3.41 million tonnes of hot-rolled steel, 1.177 million tonnes of cold-rolled steel and 183,000 tonnes of silicon steel plates in 1996, the newspaper said.
The steelmaker aims to produce eight million tonnes of steel this year, the newspaper said.
Wugang used a total of $580 million of foreign funds in the 1991-1995 period to purchase advanced equipment from countries including the United States, Germany and Japan.
It expects to attract $500 million of foreign capital in the 1996-2000 period. No details of any cooperation plans involving foreign companies were disclosed.
